name: 6pcs Ear Cleaning & Pick Set Portable Stainless Steel Set With Lather Case
description:
6pcs Ear Cleaning & Pick Set Portable Stainless Steel Set With Lather Case 
Tools Color: Silver 
PU Lather Case: Yellow and Black 
Material: Stainless steel 
Packet Materials: PU Lather 
The innovative spring earwax cleaning kit is an innovative ear cleaning tool, safe and painless. 
It is made of high-quality stainless steel and is specifically designed to extract excess wax safely and comfortably. 
It can prevent damage to ear drums and damage to hearing. 
It has a spiral groove tip, which can reach the perfect distance from the ear and effectively remove earwax. 
6pcs ear cleaning kit 
100% brand new quality
